privacy.note: Detailed device-local records are intentionally excluded from the public branch.

validated_features.battery: Persistent shell meter plus a bounded voltage-derived percentage and raw millivolts in Power; this is not a fuel gauge or charge-state estimate.
validated_features.audio: Independent persistent Boot Sounds and Game Audio levels from 0 through 10, with safe zero defaults.
validated_features.scrolling: Native 768x480 cached launcher scrolling, conservative partial presentation, functional scrollbar thumb dragging, and the operator-selected 0.5.12 touch/filter cadence.
validated_features.usb_storage: Physical-local H1 control can request eject-gated H2 USB Drive ownership without permitting concurrent app and host filesystem access.
validated_features.games: Full-resolution game presentation and removable-SD catalog behavior remain intact.

accepted: The periodic three-to-four-second stutter is absent.
Native-resolution fonts and representative games are preserved.
operator_outcome.known_limitation: Continuous finger-follow and direction-reversal latency remains perceptible.
operator_outcome.selection_reason: Direct operator comparison found 0.5.12 better than the later performance experiments.
